lifecycleBudget._note: zero = every counter 0. The two screen files carry the counts MEASURED by lifecycleCounts() on the day of the pin; a change in either file must be re-measured and re-pinned here (PLAN C-GOV-4). null = file not there yet at pin time; the lifecycle test stays red until it is pinned.
